panels.description: Maximum 15-minute grid power per day, per site. One spike sets the month's demand charge — this panel is where that spike is visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) AS "time", split_part(topic, '/', 2) AS "site", MAX(value) AS "peak_kw" FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/%/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily peak by site (kW)

panels.description: Peak kW x the site's tariff from the tariffs table (currently $18/kW-month, illustrative). Change the tariff row, not this query, to reprice.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(r.value) * t.demand_charge_per_kw_month AS demand_charge FROM readings r JOIN tariffs t ON t.site = 'mumbai-tower' WHERE r.topic = 'gridpulse/mumbai-tower/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(r.ts)

panels.title: Demand charge — Mumbai Tower ($, selected period peak)

panels.description: Peak kW x the site's tariff from the tariffs table (currently $25/kW-month, illustrative).

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(r.value) * t.demand_charge_per_kw_month AS demand_charge FROM readings r JOIN tariffs t ON t.site = 'pune-plant' WHERE r.topic = 'gridpulse/pune-plant/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(r.ts)

panels.title: Demand charge — Pune Plant ($, selected period peak)

panels.description: Daily grid energy converted at 0.71 kg/kWh (location) and 0.82 kg/kWh (market, residual mix, illustrative). Two series from one query: location is the first value column, market the second.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) AS "time", SUM(value) * 0.71 / 1000.0 AS "location", SUM(value) * 0.82 / 1000.0 AS "market" FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/%/grid-01/energy_kwh' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily carbon by method (tCO2e/day)

panels.description: One row per site per month: peak kW and peak x tariff. This is the table finance should reconcile against the utility bill — if it disagrees, check meter coverage first, not the dashboard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', r.ts) AS month, split_part(r.topic, '/', 2) AS site, MAX(r.value) AS peak_kw, MAX(r.value) * t.demand_charge_per_kw_month AS demand_charge FROM readings r JOIN tariffs t ON t.site = split_part(r.topic, '/', 2) WHERE r.topic LIKE 'gridpulse/%/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(r.ts) GROUP BY 1, 2, t.demand_charge_per_kw_month ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Monthly peak & demand charge by site
